description.value: Curry Hut Indian Bistro is an authentic Indian restaurant in downtown Vancouver serving traditional Mughlai-style curries alongside innovative contemporary Indian dishes, with a menu spanning tandoori, vegetarian specialities, and Indo-Chinese options. Located on Howe Street in the heart of the business district, the restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, and full catering services for events. The elegantly decorated space with India-inspired decor makes it a notable stop for cyclists exploring the downtown core.
